name: Anemo Treasure Compass
description:
A compass that can be used in Mondstadt to search for nearby treasure and relevant clues.
The needle of the Treasure Compass doesn't spin according to the world's magnetic field, but rather follows the energy of ley lines to lead the user to treasure.
fullDescription: A handy tool used to locate nearby chests and relevant clues. The needle of the Treasure Compass doesn't spin according to the world's magnetic field, but rather follows the energy of ley lines to lead the user to treasure. It is rumored that some adventurers are vehemently against the use of such tools, because of strongly held ideals such as "treasure hunting is about the journey, not the destination," and so on...
